scope: same fixed 600, FY2013-2024, publication through 2025-12-31; no financial values or market effects
mode: plan by default, no HTTP unless exact approved execute contract
stage_boundary: catalog waves contain only deterministic unissued pages; unknown pages after page 1 require a new frozen snapshot and contract. PDF stage requires all catalogs complete and a frozen unique target list.
request_budget: each execute contract binds exactly the frozen operation list and its finite count; prior journal starts, including unfinished and failed starts, are counted and excluded from new requests; cumulative counts are written to the result manifest
execution_guards: original final manifest, progress, journal and acquirer hashes must agree
same 600 codes and original category, URL, PDF target, concurrency, pacing, timeout, no retry and byte limits
create-only child of the original external result directory, fixed UUID and device, >=10 GiB free reserve
durable start/finish journal, prior 429 or two consecutive errors forbid new stages, and a preceding single failure is carried into the next stage
limitations: Original acquisition was still active during development; final progress and request budget have not been frozen.
A started failed or interrupted request cannot be recovered by this tool; it remains an explicit unknown.
A catalog reporting more than 30 pages remains incomplete under the original per-query page cap.
